title: The Shard of Prima
dek: The southern Prima landmark labeled “The Shard” on the island map.
body:
The island map places “The Shard” in southern Prima, south of the First Forest.

A landmark of Prima

This is a separate mapped landmark from the Shard of Fein Uaill. The Prima label alone does not establish its powers, origin, or deeper history.
sources: Prima island map · The Shard label south of the First Forest · assets/archive/prima-map.jpg
